target.request_header_provenance: Upstream VOICE_HEADERS BASE_HEADERS and generated MUID Cookie; never log values
target.purpose: voice-list metadata only; neither synthesis nor WSS health-check proof

authorization.approval_must_specify: exact hostname/path/protocol, DNS policy, one GET maximum, runner/time scope, redaction and termination

proposed_nonexecuting_algorithm: Verify narrow owner authorization before any external operation; default deny DNS and HTTPS
Use audited single-request client only; do not invoke unmodified edge_tts.list_voices(), CLI --list-voices or wrapper that silently retries
Set HTTPS GET budget=1 and disable HTTP client status retries/redirects and application-level clock skew recall; disclose separately DNS operations
Generate necessary protocol request values only in memory immediately before approved attempt; never log URL, values, Cookie or headers
On first response/error, sanitize into predefined allowlist; for HTTP 403 emit BLOCKED_UPSTREAM_403 and terminate with no second GET
On timeout, redirect, unexpected status or redaction risk stop; do not fall back to other host/version/proxy/voice, and never synthesize
Write only sanitized minimal proof after successful in-memory redaction; keep actual stage1 audio BLOCKED until independently obtained audio evidence
acceptance_gates: Baseline original Run and upstream retry risk pinned
Present-time external operation count remains zero and all permissions false
Single GET, redirects zero, 403 retry zero, clock-skew re-call zero
DNS and HTTPS approvals independently explicit with operation counts
No synthesis, MP3, SRT, WSS test or claims of acoustic verification
First 403/timeout/redirect/error fails closed with sanitized evidence only
Sensitive fields never appear in persisted logs and redaction failure produces no artifact
All production/publication locks false and no auto execution
